sources.locator: 8 workers; global batch 1024; micro batch 16; seed 42

backbone_size_note: Section 4 specifies the backbone family; Table 1 does not identify a unique parameter count. Do not assume it is matched to this run's 1.5B Base model.
limitations: No Video Games results are reported in the original Table 1 or repository result image. Cross-domain values are context, not a matched reproduction target.
Only K=3,5,10 are published in Table 1. No values at K=1,20,50 are inferred or interpolated.
This run is Qwen2.5-1.5B Base SFT only; the original main result uses the paper's complete post-training recipe.
Use Table 1 consistently: the Industrial row in Table 3 has different values and is a separate experiment.
The paper and current launcher differ in some setup details; the current run_config.json is authoritative for this experiment.
Differences in domain, catalog size, sequence length, SID selection, alignment tasks and training stage prevent attribution of a score gap to a single cause.
Paper loss curves are not a matched numeric target across tokenizers, task mixtures and label masking. Before/after loss in this run must use the same token-weighted answer-only evaluation protocol.
